Evan: Spotted intermittent out-of-order streaming when hedges resume midflight. Small tokens, high qps.
Priya: Same class of bug we saw. What's the root cause?
Evan: Race: hedge resumes and gateway swaps writer without guaranteeing primary has finished emitting buffered frames.
Diego: Suggest per-request writer lease in gateway. New conn requests lease; current writer gets soft-drain and gateway performs atomic swap.
Priya: Pros: preserves order and billing correctness. Cons: can delay hedge output. Make it a route config (swap_mode).
Evan: Also need per-req buffer caps and a lease TTL persisted to control-plane so crashes don't stall progress.
Diego: Add metrics: swap_attempt, swap_success_ms, swap_revoke. Add unit tests simulating mid-swap crash.
infra-bot: Reminder: file infra RFC if store schema changes.
Priya: Action items: spike lease SRAM shim (Diego), gateway swap flow (Evan), perf bench (Priya).
